lock-sync.name: actions.lock is in sync with the workflow YAML

steps.name: Check out without actions/checkout
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git init -q .
git remote add origin "https://github.com/${REPO}.git"
git fetch -q --depth 1 origin "${SHA}"
git checkout -q FETCH_HEAD
echo "checked out ${SHA}"

steps.name: Install pinned YAML parser
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/lock-tools"
curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL --retry 3 https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/v4.54.1/yq_linux_amd64 -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/lock-tools/yq"
echo "8e34fc298390875de416e6a4afcb8cabeceb25d9aa8506c1a2f9353cf702ea5f  $RUNNER_TEMP/lock-tools/yq" | sha256sum --check
chmod u+x "$RUNNER_TEMP/lock-tools/yq"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/lock-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Verify lockfile synchronisation
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test -x scripts/check-lock-sync.sh \
  || { echo "::error::scripts/check-lock-sync.sh missing or not executable"; exit 1; }
./scripts/check-lock-sync.sh
